items.title: CELEX:52026PC0560: Proposal for a COUNCIL DIRECTIVE amending Directives 2003/49/EC, 2009/133/EC, 2011/96/EU, (EU) 2016/1164, (EU)2017/1852, (EU) 2025/50 as regards the simplification of the Union framework on direct taxation and supporting growth and competitiveness of the EU
items.summary: This proposal aims to simplify the EU direct taxation framework by amending several key directives. It seeks to reduce administrative burdens, resolve double taxation disputes, and foster growth and competitiveness for businesses operating across the EU.
items.financeImpact: Potential reduction in compliance costs and streamlined cross-border tax dispute resolutions, improving long-term tax planning efficiency.
items.action: Monitor the legislative progress of this proposal to assess future impacts on cross-border corporate tax structures.

items.title: CELEX:52026PC0308: Proposal for a COUNCIL DIRECTIVE on administrative cooperation in the field of taxation (recast)
items.summary: This proposal recasts the EU framework for administrative cooperation in taxation. It aims to strengthen transparency, improve information exchange between member states, and adapt tax administration to modern digital business models.
items.financeImpact: May lead to stricter tax reporting requirements and increased audit scrutiny, requiring robust financial data tracking systems.
items.action: Review internal tax reporting workflows to ensure readiness for enhanced transparency and information exchange standards.
